sentences.text: iii) The Arresting Officer while preparing arrest memo did not follow the provisions of 36(b)(I) of the BNSS as the arrest memo of the revisionist was not signed by respectable member of society where the arrest was made.

On the other hand, Ld. Addl. PP for state / respondent no.1 has vehemently opposed the present revision petition and it is argued that the impugned order passed by the Ld. Trial Court is correct and that there is no merit in the present revision petition.

It is argued that the revisionist was earlier declared Proclaimed Offender by the Court of Ld. MM-05, North-District, Rohini Courts, Delhi, vide order dated 20.12.2018 and supplementary charge-sheet was also filed against her.
It is further argued that the revisionist was declared Proclaimed Offender vide the afore- mentioned order dated 20.12.2018, however, the said order has not been challenged by the revisionist.
It is also argued that specific allegations have been leveled against revisionist in the FIR and she was fully aware about the same.

It is further argued that revisionist was declared Proclaimed Offender after following procedures established by law and that there is no error in the impugned order dated 24.05.2025 which is free from any error, therefore, present revision petition may kindly be dismissed.

opennyai_summary.ANALYSIS:
Perusal of the TCR shows that an FIR bearing No.362/2018 PS Shahbad Dairy was registered on the complaint of Ms.Neelam for the offences punishable under section Digitally signed by SUSHIL Suman Vs. The State & Ors.
Perusal of the file shows that during the course of investigation, revisionist was declared Proclaimed Offender vide order dated 20.12.2018.
8. Perusal of the TCR further shows that after her arrest in the afore-mentioned Kalandra being a Proclaimed Offender, she (revisionist/accused) was produced before the Court of Ld. JMFC,
North-District, Rohini Courts, Delhi and she was sent to Judicial Custody for two days.
Perusal of the TCR further shows that revisionist was formally arrested in the present case by the Investigation Officer after seeking permission from the concerned Court of Ld. JMFC having jurisdiction over the area of PS Shahbad Dairy and a separate ground of arrest was prepared by Investigation Officer at the time of her arrest.
Thus, the judgments relied upon by Ld. Counsel for revisionist does not rely to the facts of the present case.
opennyai_summary.decision:
From perusal of the TCR, it can be easily observed that revisionist had absconded immediately after registration of FIR and consequently, she was declared Proclaimed offender vide order dated 20.12.2018 and she was arrested vide Kalandra Under section 35(1) (d) BNSS being a Proclaimed Offender after about five years and six months.
From the perusal of the whole TCR, this Court does not find any illegality, infirmity or perversity in the impugned order dated 24.05.2025.
Same is accordingly up-held and the present revision petition is hereby dismissed.
10. A copy of this order be made available to both the parties and be also sent to the ld. Trial Court along with the TCR.
